title: Hom comparisons for the explicit affine chart ring diagram
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I to CommRingCat a diagram, and c a limiting cone of its opposite spectrum diagram with affine vertex [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix i <= j, f:Xi to Spec R(i), an open cover U of the base change of Xi to Spec R(j), and an affine chart A=U(a) [def-pc-base-change, def-pc-fibre-product]. Let M,N be quasi-coherent modules on A [pqf-def-coherent]; finite presentation is not assumed. Let g:A to Spec R(j) be the chart map followed by the base projection. Let J be the partial-order quotient of the upper tail of j, H its monotone representative functor, and t the class of j. Define F by global sections of upperTailChartDiagram R j g, precomposed with H. Define P,Q as the global sections of the actual pullbacks of M,N on the chart at H(t), regarded as modules over F(t). There is a Hom equivalence alpha from scalar-extension Hom(P,Q) at colimit F to ordinary Hom on the direct limit chart. For each x>=t, with k=H(x) and the prescribed maps q,p,q0,w, there is a Hom equivalence beta from scalar-extension Hom(P,Q) at F(x) to ordinary Hom on the stage chart. For every algebraic map phi at the colimit and s at F(x), and every pair eP,eQ of composition isomorphisms normalized on 1-tensors, if phi composed with eQ equals eP composed with the further scalar extension of s, then chartOrdinaryMapRecovery q p q0 w U a M N (alpha phi) (beta s) holds [def-pc-chart-ordinary-map-recovery]. This gives only universal-property comparisons, not existence of a stage map.

proof.text: Apply canonical affine Hom naturality to obtain alpha and beta. This geometric comparison has no arbitrary normalized composition isomorphisms and no independently supplied algebraic square.

Construct the scalar-extension composition isomorphism from the cocone equation and Mathlib ModuleCat.extendScalarsComp. Its unit-tensor formula is extendScalarsComp_hom_app_one_tmul, after transporting along the ring-map equality. The supplied eP,eQ have the same values on unit tensors. ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.hom_ext and Iso.ext therefore identify them with these canonical isomorphisms.

Postcompose the supplied algebraic square with eQ.inv and cancel eQ.hom. Replace eP,eQ by their canonical comparisons to identify phi with the conjugated scalar extension of s. Substitute this equality and apply the canonical geometric naturality assertion.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_chart_ordinary_hom_comparison
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (U : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).OpenCover.{u})
    (a : U.I₀) (ha : IsAffine (U.X a))
    (M N : (U.X a).Modules)
    (hMq : M.IsQuasicoherent)
    (hNq : N.IsQuasicoherent)
    :
    let g := U.f a ≫ pullback.snd f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))
    let F := ordinaryChartRings R j g
    let t := ordinaryChartStart j
    let P := ordinaryChartBaseModule R j g M
    let Q := ordinaryChartBaseModule R j g N
    let r₀ := (colimit.ι F t).hom
    let q₀ := baseChangeMap f
      (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
      (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
      (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))
    ∃ α : ((ModuleCat.extendScalars r₀).obj P ⟶
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars r₀).obj Q) ≃
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q₀ a)).obj M ⟶
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q₀ a)).obj N),
      ∀ (x : OrdinaryChartTail I j) (htx : t ≤ x),
        let k := ((ordinaryChartRep j).obj x).val
        let hjk := ((ordinaryChartRep j).obj x).property
        let q := baseChangeMap f
          (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
          (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
          (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjk)))
            (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl))
        let p := baseChangeMap f
          (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
          (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
          (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op k)) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)).op))
        let q₀ := baseChangeMap f
          (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
          (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
          (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))
        let w : p ≫ q = q₀ := by
          rw [← baseChangeMap_comp]
          congr 1
          ext
          simpa using c.w (homOfLE hjk).op
        let r := (F.map (homOfLE htx)).hom
        let r₁ := (colimit.ι F x).hom
        ∃ β : ((ModuleCat.extendScalars r).obj P ⟶
            (ModuleCat.extendScalars r).obj Q) ≃
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q a)).obj M ⟶
            (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q a)).obj N),
          ∀ (φ : (ModuleCat.extendScalars r₀).obj P ⟶
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars r₀).obj Q)
            (s : (ModuleCat.extendScalars r).obj P ⟶
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars r).obj Q)
            (eP : (ModuleCat.extendScalars r₀).obj P ≅
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars r₁).obj ((ModuleCat.extendScalars r).obj P))
            (eQ : (ModuleCat.extendScalars r₀).obj Q ≅
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars r₁).obj ((ModuleCat.extendScalars r).obj Q)),
            (∀ m : P, eP.hom ((1 : ↑(colimit F)) ⊗ₜ[F.obj t, r₀] m) =
              (1 : ↑(colimit F)) ⊗ₜ[F.obj x, r₁] ((1 : ↑(F.obj x)) ⊗ₜ[F.obj t, r] m)) →
            (∀ n : Q, eQ.hom ((1 : ↑(colimit F)) ⊗ₜ[F.obj t, r₀] n) =
              (1 : ↑(colimit F)) ⊗ₜ[F.obj x, r₁] ((1 : ↑(F.obj x)) ⊗ₜ[F.obj t, r] n)) →
            φ ≫ eQ.hom = eP.hom ≫ (ModuleCat.extendScalars r₁).map s →
            chartOrdinaryMapRecovery q p q₀ w U a M N (α φ) (β s)
